name: dredging-streams-banish-card-from-opponent-graveyard
notes: Dredging Streams (wmt0x5zado): "Banish target card from a graveyard." -- any graveyard. Same setup as dredging-streams-banish-card-from-own-graveyard, but the opponent's Fluffy Shopkeep is chosen: it is banished into the OPPONENT's banishment (the handler redirects to the graveyard owner's banish zone) and player 1's own graveyard is untouched.

rulesClauses: Banish target card from A graveyard -- including the opponent's graveyard (it is banished from there, into its owner's banishment).
